title: Bar ramp, three models

techniques.name: Counts as bars

width.label: Bar width
width.note: Width of each bar against its slot. Below 1 opens a gap between the bars.

bars.label: Bars
bars.note: How many bars stand in the ramp. The model handoffs move with them.

height.label: Height
height.note: Height of every bar against the frame: held clear of the brackets and the frame top, and tall enough to hold the frame.

depth.label: Depth
depth.note: How deep each bar is drawn: 0 flattens it to its front face.

techniques.implementation: Counts are drawn as bars in two or three greens, with a dashed baseline for the expected value. Drawn by the source page’s own code, with its camera, steps, focus and bars given dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
